ai_summary: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd. delivered an exceptionally strong Q2 FY27, reporting over 30% year-over-year revenue growth and more than doubling its EBITDA and PAT, alongside significant margin expansion. This robust performance was primarily driven by the dominant CDMO segment's double-digit volume growth and improved API prices, with operating leverage and strategic improvements in other segments also contributing to enhanced profitability. No material red flags were identified, as the company demonstrated strong execution in its core business and made progress in turning around previously challenging segments.
